cohort: 100 pregnant women in their third trimester with iron deficiency anemia (hemoglobin >7.5 g/dL and <11 g/dL) who were intolerant or non-compliant to oral iron, or deemed suitable for iron sucrose by their clinician, at a single center in Bihta, Patna, Bihar, India.
finding: Intravenous iron sucrose significantly increased hemoglobin levels by 11.07% at 6 weeks and 11.82% at term, and serum ferritin levels by 60.11% at term, in pregnant women with iron deficiency anemia.
